earnings.title: Ingersoll Rand Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Reported net income attributable to Ingersoll Rand Inc. of $670 million, $1.73 per share
Adjusted net income attributable to Ingersoll Rand Inc. 1 of $415 million, $1.07 per share, up 24%
Adjusted net income attributable to Ingersoll Rand Inc. 1 , excluding IEEPA Tariff Refunds, of $390 million, $1.01 per share, up 17%
Reported revenues of $2,065 million, up 6%, or up 4% organic
Reported operating cash flow of $648 million and free cash flow 1 of $623 million

quotes.text: We delivered strong organic orders growth and revenue performance in the third quarter, reflecting an improved demand environment and continued execution by our teams.
quotes.by: Vicente Reynal, chairman and chief executive officer of Ingersoll Rand

items.heading: We have exposure to the risks associated with instability in the global economy, financial markets and our end markets, which may negatively impact our revenues, liquidity, suppliers and customers.
More than half of our sales and operations are in non-U.S. jurisdictions and we are subject to the economic, political, regulatory and other risks of international operations.
Information systems failure or disruption, due to cyber terrorism or other actions, may adversely impact our business and result in financial loss to the Company or liability to our customers.
Acquisitions, including integrating such acquisitions, and dispositions create certain risks and may affect our operating results.
We face competition in the markets we serve, which could materially and adversely affect our operating results.
The nature of our products creates the possibility of significant product liability, warranty claims, and product recalls, which could harm our business.
